verdict.rationale: The Business Formation page offers a "streamlined service" to file certificates of formation and positions the Premier Business Services account as something for businesses that "frequently" file or need shared payment access. That implies a founder can start the core formation flow without an account, and name search and standing-certificate lookups are also offered online without any account requirement mentioned. However, no published page explicitly says the flow is keyless or describes a file-number or business-ID entry path; this is inferred from how the optional account is framed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that formation can begin without an account, a documented file-number/keyless entry path, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
